policy: ทุก import ข้าม layer ต้องอยู่ในกราฟนี้ — เพิ่ม edge ใหม่ต้อง approve

notes.app_wide: app/ (pages + API routes) can import from all presentation and execution layers for command dispatch
notes.app_cognitive: app/api/chat/route.ts uses lib/cognitive/pipeline for the cognitive command pipeline
notes.cognitive_all: lib/cognitive/ orchestrates the full pipeline — imports from supabase, documents, v2-rules, v3-engines, v5-presenter, v6-executor
notes.v3_self: v3-engines sub-modules can import each other (e.g., debt/engine imports config-loader)
notes.v4_no_runtime: v4-ai ห้าม import runtime/engine — AI แปลอย่างเดียว ไม่ register command เอง
notes.v5_no_v3: v5-presenter ห้าม import v3-engines — caller (app/) inject calcDistance/configs ผ่าน parameter
notes.v6_self: v6-executor sub-modules can import each other (drivers, core, runtime)
notes.v6_v2: v6-executor/gateway.ts imports v2-rules/actions for permission check before execute
notes.v6_supabase: v6-executor/executor.ts uses supabase for audit logging
